name: s7-baseline
description: Sprint 7 baseline on the released v0.0.195 package: the released product's own save-free review phases in the owned fixtures, with no other mods. r3-ui opens the owned Trample/Overrun description windows (VIS-03 before); r6-presentation plays the Trumpet Archon blast and Vrock screech cues with their native lifetimes (VIS-06 before); r7-models and r7-models-interior capture the shipped R7 Nalfeshnee in bright and dim fixtures (VIS-01 before). Evidence only; no product or harness change. The short name keeps evidence paths under MAX_PATH.
